_description: Base ports for labs servers. Consumed by external projects (e.g. loom) to compute port offsets. Changing a value here changes it for all consumers.
_blockedPortsDescription: Ports that clients refuse to talk to: browsers and Deno's fetch both implement the WHATWG bad-port list, and reject a request to one of these before opening a connection. A server binds such a port normally, so nothing complains at startup and a curl health check passes, but every browser page load and every server-to-server fetch fails. An offset must therefore never land a server on one. Regenerate by probing each port with fetch against a host that cannot resolve: a blocked port reports "Requests to port N are blocked" without any network work, and every other port reports a DNS failure.
